# onetsolutions_instance_backups (Data Source)

Lists the backups of an instance, newest first, on-demand and scheduled ones alike.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "onetsolutions_instance_backups" "web" {
  instance_id = onetsolutions_instance.web.id
  status      = "completed"
}

output "latest_restorable_backup" {
  value = try(data.onetsolutions_instance_backups.web.backups[0].id, null)
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `instance_id` (String) The UUID of the instance.

### Optional

- `organization_id` (String) The organization to read from. Defaults to the provider's `organization_id`.
- `project_id` (String) The project to read from. Defaults to the provider's `project_id`.
- `status` (String) Only list the backups with this status, such as `completed` for those that can be restored. When unset, every backup is listed.

### Read-Only

- `backups` (Attributes List) The backups, newest first. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--backups))

<a id="nestedatt--backups"></a>
### Nested Schema for `backups`

Read-Only:

- `backup_type` (String) `manual` or `scheduled`.
- `created` (String) When the backup was requested (RFC 3339).
- `expires_at` (String) When the backup expires (RFC 3339).
- `id` (String) The UUID of the backup.
- `name` (String) The name of the backup.
- `retention_days` (Number) How many days the backup is kept.
- `size_gb` (String) The size of the backup in GB, a decimal; null until it is complete.
- `status` (String) The status of the backup: `pending`, `running`, `completed`, `failed`, `deleting` or `deleted`.
